parsed.name: 数据采集流水线阶段
parsed.description: 用于实验数据采集系统中的单个处理阶段的软件组件，负责在采集流水线中组织进程、队列和消息传递，并可配置具体处理类。它常用于高通量实验或探测器数据流的在线处理、分发、预处理以及按批次标识保存数据。
parsed.description_en: A software component representing a single stage in an experimental data acquisition pipeline. It manages processes, queues, and message passing, and can be configured with a specific processing class. It is used for online handling, routing, preprocessing, and train-ID-based saving of streaming experimental or detector data.

actions.description: 获取/设置流水线中的阶段位置。
actions.description_en: Get/set the stage position in the pipeline.

actions.description: 获取/设置构建时要启动的进程数量。
actions.description_en: Get/set the number of processes to spawn when built.

actions.description: 配置该采集阶段所使用的处理类及其参数。
actions.description_en: Configure the processing class and its parameters for this acquisition stage.

actions.description: 设置该阶段的初始化参数。
actions.description_en: Set the initialization arguments for this stage.

actions.description: 获取该阶段当前管理的进程对象。

actions.description: 构建该采集阶段并连接输入/输出队列。
